candidates.verbatim_passage: On average across all 15 HINs in the US, loss of irrigation increased heat wave frequency, duration, and intensity by 0.70 events/year, 0.62 days/event, and 0.24°C. Heat wave frequency and duration was significantly increased without irrigation in California's Central Valley and the Southern High Plains for up to 8 out of 15 HINs (figures S1 and S2), with the greatest increases in the Southern High Plains of up to 3 events/year and 2 days/event for frequency and duration respectively (figures 1(a) and (b)).
